title_en: Whole and Parts: The Little Flowered Coat
page_text_ocr_zh:
小花袄
整体与部分
page_text_en:
Little Flowered Coat
Whole and Parts
summary_zh: 本页展示了一件红色带黄色花朵图案的棉袄，上方木牌写着“小花袄 整体与部分”，背景为蓝天绿地，暗示本页主题为认识整体与部分的关系。

title_en: Whole and Parts: The Little Flowered Coat
page_text_ocr_zh: 大风呼呼地刮，天气越来越冷了……
page_text_en: The wind howls, and the weather is getting colder and colder...
summary_zh: 本页描绘了大风呼啸、天气变冷的场景，为后续故事发展做铺垫。

title_en: Whole and Parts: The Little Flowered Coat
page_text_ocr_zh: 草丛里掉了一件小花袄。
page_text_en: A little floral coat fell out of the grass.
summary_zh: 草丛中掉落了一件红色带黄色花朵图案的小花袄，背景是蓝天绿地，暗示天气转冷。

title_en: Whole and Parts: The Little Flowered Coat
page_text_ocr_zh:
一只小老鼠经过，他冷得发抖。
小老鼠拆下了小花袄的毛领。
page_text_en:
A little mouse passed by, shivering from the cold.
The little mouse took off the fur collar of the floral coat.
summary_zh: 一只小老鼠因寒冷经过草丛，发现掉落的小花袄，并拆下了它的毛领。

title_en: Whole and Parts: The Little Flowered Coat
page_text_en: "I feel much warmer," said the little mouse.
summary_zh: 小老鼠戴着从花袄上拆下的毛领，感到暖和，并说出自己的感受。

title_en: Whole and Parts: The Little Flowered Coat
page_text_ocr_zh:
一只小刺猬经过，他冷得发抖。
小刺猬拆下了小花袄的衣袖。
page_text_en:
A little hedgehog passed by, shivering from the cold.
He took off one sleeve of the little flowered coat.
summary_zh: 一只小刺猬因寒冷经过草丛，发现掉落的小花袄，拆下了一只衣袖裹在身上取暖。

title_en: Whole and Parts: The Little Flowered Coat
page_text_en: "I feel much warmer now," said the little hedgehog.
summary_zh: 小刺猬裹着从花袄上拆下的衣袖，感到暖和，并说出自己的感受。

title_en: Whole and Parts: The Little Flowered Coat
page_text_ocr_zh: 一只小熊经过，他冷得发抖。现在，只剩下红色的花背心。
page_text_en: A little bear passes by, shivering from the cold. Now, only the red floral vest remains.
summary_zh: 一只小熊因寒冷发抖，经过草丛时发现只剩下红色花背心的小花袄。

title_en: Whole and Parts: The Little Flowered Coat
page_text_en: "I feel much warmer now," said the little bear.
summary_zh: 小熊穿上小花袄剩下的红色花背心，感到暖和，并说出自己的感受。

title_en: Whole and Parts: The Little Flowered Coat
page_text_ocr_zh:
小花袄的整体被拆成了三个部分。

大家都不冷了。
page_text_en:
The little floral coat was broken down into three parts.

Nobody is cold anymore.
summary_zh: 本页展示了小花袄被拆分为毛领、衣袖和背心三部分，分别被小老鼠、小刺猬和小熊使用，三只小动物都因此感到暖和，不再寒冷。

title_en: Whole and Parts: The Little Flowered Coat
page_text_ocr_zh: 风慢慢停了，太阳出来了……
page_text_en: The wind slowly stopped, and the sun came out...
summary_zh: 风停了，太阳出来了，天气转晴，预示着寒冷天气的结束。
